about: Same five-step ladder as reviews.json (see its 'about'). {X} = the name he picks or types; {a}/{plural} = the kind of thing. 'against' marks the other side (the empty square on the card).
name: Article
how: An article in five sentences: one to hook the reader, two to describe and tell a story, one honest downside, and a last thought. All about something you love.
notebook: Write your article about {X} in five sentences, one per slot. Give it a title. Then check:
ticks: My title and first line make you want to read on.
I spoke to the reader directly.
I told a little story or gave an example.
My ending leaves the reader with a thought.

ways.t: Have you ever wondered what makes {X} so special?
Imagine a world without {X}. Hard to picture, isn’t it?
Let me tell you why {X} means so much to me.

slots.job: say what you love about it

ways.t: For me personally, the best thing about {X} is …
What I love most about {X} is …
The first thing you notice about {X} is …

slots.job: tell a moment or give an example

ways.t: I will never forget the day when …
One moment that really stands out is when …
Let me give you an example of what I mean: …
Of course, not everything about {X} is perfect: …
The only thing I would change is …

slots.job: leave the reader with a thought

ways.t: So, if you haven’t tried {X} yet, what are you waiting for?
In the end, life would be much duller without {X}.
Next time you have a free afternoon, why not give {X} a try?
